description: 11e FIRE OVERWATCH (15.08) with the HUD 'Skip Overwatch' toggle left ON (its default): the auto-decline of a REAL offer. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive (P1 Custodes active, round 2, 6 CP each): the Ork player has FIRE OVERWATCH rows (Flash Gitz, Tankbustas — asserted) and FIRE OVERWATCH is the only thing its movement_phase_end window offers. The Custodes player ends the Movement phase with the phase button: the window DOES open for Player 2 with the FIRE OVERWATCH offer (recorded from the phase's stratagem_window_opened signal), Main drops the offer because Skip Overwatch is ON and, with nothing else offered, declines the window for Player 2 — no stratagem dialog is ever created, no CP is spent, no stratagem is recorded, no snap shot is rolled, and the Movement phase ends (Shooting).
